questions.section: Phan I. Trac Nghiem Nhieu Phuong An Lua Chon
questions.stem: Gia tri تich phan xac dinh $I = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (2\sin x + \cos x)\,dx$ bang bao nhieu?

stem_blocks.content: Gia tri tich phan xac dinh $I = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (2\sin x + \cos x)\,dx$ bang bao nhieu?

questions.explanation: Ta co nguyen ham: $I = \left[-2\cos x + \sin x\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} = (0 + 1) - (-2 + 0) = 3$.

questions.section: Phan I. Trac Nghiem Nhieu Phuong An Lua Chon
questions.stem: Trong khong gian $Oxyz$, cho mat phang $(P): 2x - y + 3z - 6 = 0$. Vectơ nao duoi day la mot vecto phap tuyen cua mat phang $(P)$?

stem_blocks.content: Trong khong gian $Oxyz$, cho mat phang $(P): 2x - y + 3z - 6 = 0$. Vecto nao duoi day la mot vecto phap tuyen cua mat phang $(P)$?

questions.explanation: Mat phang $(P): Ax + By + Cz + D = 0$ co vecto phap tuyen la $\vec{n} = (A; B; C) = (2; -1; 3)$.

statements.content: Tai thoi diem ban dau $t = 0$, chat diem dang o vi tri can bang $x = 0$.

statements.content: Toc do cuc dai cua chat diem trong qua trinh dao dong la $v_{\max} = 20\pi\text{ cm/s}$.

questions.explanation: a) Dung: $A = 4\text{ cm}$. b) Dung: $T = \frac{2\pi}{\omega} = \frac{2\pi}{5\pi} = 0.4\text{ s}$. c) Sai: Tai $t = 0$, $x(0) = 4\cos(-\pi/3) = 2\text{ cm} \neq 0$. d) Dung: $v_{\max} = \omega A = 5\pi \cdot 4 = 20\pi\text{ cm/s}$.

questions.section: Phan III. Trac Nghiem Tra Loi Ngan
questions.stem: Cho hinh chop tu giac deu $S.ABCD$ co canh day $AB = 6$ va chieu cao $SO = 4$, voi $O$ la tam cua day $ABCD$. Tinh the tich $V$ cua khoi chop $S.ABCD$ (nhap ket qua la so nguyen).

stem_blocks.content: Cho hinh chop tu giac deu $S.ABCD$ co canh day $AB = 6$ va chieu cao $SO = 4$, voi $O$ la tam cua day $ABCD$. Tinh the tich $V$ cua khoi chop $S.ABCD$ (nhap ket qua la so nguyen).

questions.explanation: Dien tich day hinh vuong $S_{ABCD} = AB^2 = 6^2 = 36$. The tich khoi chop $V = \frac{1}{3} S_{ABCD} \cdot SO = \frac{1}{3} \cdot 36 \cdot 4 = 48$.

questions.section: Phan IV. Lua Chon Da Dap An (Kiem Tra Tong Hop)
questions.stem: Cho ham so $f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 2$. Chon TAT CA cac khang dinh dung trong cac phuong an duoi day:

stem_blocks.content: Cho ham so $f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 2$. Chon TAT CA cac khang dinh dung trong cac phuong an duoi day:

options.label: A
options.content: Dao ham cua ham so la $f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3$.

options.label: B
options.content: Ham so dat cuc tieu tai $x = 1$ voi gia tri cuc tieu $f(1) = 0$.

options.label: C
options.content: Ham so dong bien tren khoang $(-1; 1)$.

options.label: D
options.content: Gia tri cuc dai cua ham so tren R la $f(-1) = 4$.

questions.explanation: Ta co $f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3 = 0 \Leftrightarrow x = \pm 1$. Tren $(-1; 1)$ thi $f'(x) < 0$ nen ham so nghich bien tren $(-1; 1)$ (do do C sai). Cac khang dinh A, B, D deu dung.
